title: IEANTN (Terence Tao): Explicit Primes in Short Intervals
description: Five verbatim open analytic number theory theorems from Terence Tao's Integrated Explicit Analytic Number Theory Network (teorth/IEANTN@cd9c2dd3, Apache-2.0): Kadiri–Lumley (2014) Theorem 1.1 short-interval primes above exp(59), exp(60), and all of Table 2; Ramaré–Saouter (2003) primes in (x(1 - 1/28314000), x]; and Dusart (2018) Proposition 5.4 primes in (x, x + x/(log x)^3] for x ≥ 89693. Every frozen definition file is SHA-256 identical to upstream.

tasks.title: Kadiri–Lumley (2014): prime in (x(1 - 1/1946282821), x) for x ≥ exp(59)
tasks.description: Prove `KadiriLumley.v1.prime_in_interval_above_exp_59` (Table 2 row log x₀ = 59, consumed by the odd-Goldbach chain in IEANTN).

tasks.title: Kadiri–Lumley (2014): prime in (x(1 - 1/1966196911), x) for x ≥ exp(60)
tasks.description: Prove `KadiriLumley.v1.prime_in_interval_above_exp_60` (Table 2 row log x₀ = 60, sharpest row used by the odd-Goldbach pipeline).

tasks.title: Kadiri–Lumley (2014) Theorem 1.1: all 20 rows of Table 2
tasks.description: Prove `KadiriLumley.v1.table_2`: short-interval prime guarantees for x ≥ 4·10^18 and every (n, Δ) row in `table2ExpRows` up to exp(150).

tasks.title: Ramaré–Saouter (2003): prime in (x(1 - 1/28314000), x] for x > 10726905041
tasks.description: Prove `RamareSaouter2003.v1.prime_in_short_interval`: every x > 10,726,905,041 has a prime in (x(1 - 1/28314000), x].

tasks.title: Dusart (2018) Proposition 5.4: prime in (x, x + x/(log x)^3] for x ≥ 89693
